title: CFGComposer: Compositional Audio-Text-to-Motion Generation via Copula Score Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.15101v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating whole-body gestures that are simultaneously rhythmically synchronized with speech audio and semantically aligned with text descriptions is a fundamental challenge in embodied AI and social robotics. We tackle this Audio-Text-to-Motion (AT2M) problem by composing two independently-trained diffusion models at inference time and refine bias in joint inference by modeling the copula score $s_I$. A rigorous theoretical analysis reveals that naive epsilon blending corresponds to a Product-of-Experts formulation that omits the copula score $s_I$: the cross-modal interaction between audio and text that neither marginal model can capture. We propose CFGComposer: a jointly-trained AT2M diffusion model that estimates $s_I$ via a CFG analogy and injects it as an $\epsilon$-space correction. translated_title: CFGComposer：基于Copula分数校正的组合式音频-文本到动作生成
translated_abstract: 在具身智能与社交机器人领域，生成既能与语音音频节奏同步、又与文本描述语义对齐的全身手势，是一项根本性挑战。我们通过在推理阶段组合两个独立训练的扩散模型来应对这一音频-文本到动作（AT2M）问题，并通过建模copula分数 $s_I$ 来修正联合推理中的偏差。严格的理论分析表明，朴素的epsilon混合对应于一种乘积专家式的组合方式，其遗漏了copula分数 $s_I$——即音频与文本之间的跨模态交互，这是任何单一边缘模型都无法捕捉的。我们提出CFGComposer：一个联合训练的AT2M扩散模型，通过CFG类比来估计 $s_I$，并将其作为epsilon空间的校正项注入。在BEAT数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了同类最佳的语义保真度（SRGR 0.9916，FID 27.18），并达到了与真实数据相当水平的节拍对齐效果（BA 0.1826，对比真实值 0.174...）。
tldr: 提出CFGComposer，一个联合训练的音频-文本到动作扩散模型，通过以CFG类比估计并注入copula分数校正来捕捉音频与文本之间的跨模态交互，在BEAT数据集上实现了同类最佳的语义保真度和接近真实数据的节拍对齐。
en_tdlr: CFGComposer is a jointly-trained audio-text-to-motion diffusion model that captures the cross-modal interaction between audio and text by estimating the copula score via a CFG analogy and injecting it as an epsilon-space correction, achieving state-of-the-art semantic fidelity and ground-truth-level beat alignment on BEAT.
